newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, Dec 9 - Varna - East - 5 Vessels discharging at berth, 3 awaiting orders. West - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. Lesport/tankers - No vessels. Bourgas - 27 Vessels due, 6 loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth. 7 Waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 6 under repair/drydock. West - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. Tankers - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Dec 10 - Bourgas - 17 Vessels loading of which 2 tsp, 1 urea, 4 soda, 1 wood material, 1 clinker, 1 cement, 1 sas, 2 glass, 2 sulphur acid, 1 quartz sand, 1 edc. 7 discharging, 4 coal, 1 maize, 1 coal, 1 phosphorite. 5 Vessels discharging/loading containers, 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to discharge, 1 coal, 1 phosphorite, 1 to discharge/load containers, 3 cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, Dec 9 - Rijeka - Three vessels discharging at berth, 3 loading at berth, 7 vessels under repair/drydock. 2 Vessels berthed inoperative, 2 anchored, 7 due, delays expected. Zadar - One vessel due, delays expected. Sibenik - One vessel loading at berth. Split - One vessel under repair/drydock. Pula, Rasa, Ploce, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Dec 10 - Limassol - Vessels due on 11/12, 6 containers, 2 passenger vessels, no delays expected. 4 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth, 2 ro/ro vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. Larnaca - Vessels due on 11/12, 2 containers, 1 conventional vessel, no delays expected. 2 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, Dec 9 - Tallinn - City port - 4 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth (1 map/dap, 1 silicon carbide). 2 Vessels discharging at berth (1 cocoa beans, 1 other). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load. Kopli - 5 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth (1 fertiliser, 1 sawn timber). 3 Vessels discharging at berth (1 butter, 1 meat, 1 cocoa beans). Muuga - 4 Vessels due, no delays expected. 5 Vessels loading at berth (2 blackil, 1 peat, 1 fertiliser, 1 cars). 5 Vessels discharging at berth (4 grain, 1 ferro alloys). Parnu - 5 Vessels due, no delays expected. 9 vessels loading at berth of which 2 peat, 4 timber, 2 board, 1 wood granules.

ITALY, Dec 10 - Naples - Three vessels will berth 10/12 of which 1 gas tanker, 1 bulk carrier, 1 ro/ro. Gaeta - Two vessels due to berth of which 1 general cargo, 1 freezer. Genoa commercial port - Two vessels in roads, no delays. 41 Vessels berthed, 6 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Vado Ligure - Three vessels in roads, 1 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 7 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, 35 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads, no delays.

Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - Five vessels in roads, no vessels berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - One vessel in roads, 1 berthed. Sarroch - No delays. Taranto - One vessel in roads. Ravenna - 11 Vessels in roads. Ancona/Falconara - Two vessels in roads. Venice - Five vessels in roads. Trieste - Two vessels in roads, no delays.

LATVIA, Dec 10 - Ventspils - Four vessels operating of which 1 metal loader, 1 mop loader, 1 ferro silicon loader, 1 scrap metal loader. No delays, 9 vessels due. Riga - Eight vessels operating of which 1 mop loader, 1 steel loader, 2 grain dischargers, 1 soya meal discharger, 2 tanker loaders, 1 project loader. No delays, 17 vessels due. Liepaja - Four vessels operating, no delays, 4 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, Dec 10 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 sunflowers, 3 fertiliser, 1 scrap, 1 metal, 1 oil, 1 cast iron, 1 other. Discharging, 6 fish, 1 soya pellets, 1 sugar, 1 fish powder. 4 Vessels in roads, 28 due.

POLAND, Dec 10 - Szczecin - 88 Vessels due, delays expected. 52 vessels loading at berth, 33 discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to load. 8 Vessels under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Gdynia - 13 Vessels operating, 4 general cargo loading at berth. 7 Vessels discharging at berth (2 bulk, 2 general cargo, 3 grain). 2 General cargo waiting at anchorage to load. 6 Vessels under repair/drydock, 38 due. Gdansk - 14 Vessels operating, 8 loading at berth (2 coal, 3 general cargo, 3 bulk). 6 Vessels discharging at berth (3 grain, 2 general cargo, 1 bulk). 4 Vessels under repair/drydock, 17 due.

PORTUGAL, Dec 9 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 13 general cargo, 3 container vessels. No vessels awaiting berth, no places vacant. Dec 10 - Setubal - Three vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 8 for discharging, 2 for loading, 2 under repair/drydock.

ROMANIA, Dec 10 - Constantza - 49 Vessels operating of which 16 generals (14 loading, 2 discharging), 15 bulkers (7 loading, 8 discharging), 11 bagged chemicals (10 loading, 1 discharging), 3 tankers (1 loading, 2 discharging), 2 bagged chemicals loading, 2 containers loading/discharging. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 general (2 for loading, for 1 discharging), 3 bulkers for loading, 1 bagged chemicals for loading, 2 tankers for loading, 1 bagged cement for loading. Constantza south (Agigea) - Six general cargo (5 loading, 1 discharging). Mangalia - No vessels loading/discharging. Midia - One livestock carrier loading, 1 tanker loading.

RUSSIA, Dec 9 - FAR EAST - Vladivostok - 13 Vessels in port of which 2 passenger vessels. 7 Vessels loading (1 container, 1 metal, 4 timber, 1 aluminium). Nakhodka - 14 Vessels in port of which 9 loading (4 metal, 1 general cargo, 2 timber, 2 cotton), 5 vessels waiting. Vostochniy - Nine vessels in port of which 7 loading (3 coal, 2 timber, 1 container vessel, 1 metal), 2 vessels waiting. Posiet - Two vessels loading metal. Zarubino - Two vessels loading metal. No delays or congestion in ports.

BALTIC - St. Petersburg - 23 Vessels operating of which loading, 5 non-ferrous, 2 container vessels, 7 fertiliser. Discharging, 2 frozen meat, 2 containers, 1 milk foods, 2 frozen chicken, 1 pipes, 1 citrus. 6 Vessels awaiting operations, 7 due. Kaliningrad - Six vessels operating of which 1 wheat flour loader, 1 aluminium discharger, 1 scrap discharger, 1 coal discharger, 2 grain dischargers. No delays, 4 vessels due. Vyborg - Seven vessels operating, no delays, 2 vessels due.

Dec 10 - NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Five vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 npk, 1 steel, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 coal, no berthing delays. 14 Vessels due during the week of which 10 loaders (5 apatite, 1 coal, 1 cabotage, 1 steel, 1 aluminium, 1 npk). 4 Dischargers (2 anode paste, 1 general cargo, 1 cabotage).

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - 18 Vessels operating of which 7 loading, 3 steel, 1 scrap, 1 slabs, 1 seeds, 1 soya bean meal. 11 Discharging, 2 rice, 4 various, 1 citrus, 1 sugar, 1 cars, 1 urea, 1 bananas. 13 Vessels waiting in roads of which to load seeds. 11 to discharge, 2 sugar, 1 rice, 6 citrus, 1 aluminium, 1 roof tiles. 1 To discharge/load cars. 36 Vessels due. 7 Vessels to discharge.

SLOVENIA - Koper - 11 vessels berthed of which 1 container vessel loading/discharging, 3 bulk carriers to discharge coal, alumina, manganese, 1 bulk carrier loading grain, 1 ferry loading/discharging, 2 livestock vessels loading bulls, 1 general cargo loading logs, 1 tanker discharging gasoline, 1 reefer discharging bananas. 16 Vessels due during next 2 days of which 2 car carriers to load and discharge, 3 bulk carriers to discharge coal, alumina, salt. 1 Livestock to load bulls, 1 ferry to load/discharge, 5 containers to load/discharge, 4 general cargo to load wire/rails/paper/profiles, no delays.

SPAIN, Dec 9 - Tarragona - It is announced that the public administrations throughout Spain will carry out a strike on 11/12, which will affect port operations. Sagunto - 20 Vessels operating of which 1 ro/ro discharging/loading. 3 Vessels loading perishable goods, 7 discharging steel products, 2 loading steel products, 2 loading fertiliser, 1 discharging liquid ammonia, 1 discharging logs, 2 loading fertiliser, 1 discharging/loading steel products. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays. Dec 10 - Cadiz - Ten vessels operating of which 4 ro/ro, 1 semolina, 5 under repair, no delays. Aviles - Six vessels in port of which 2 loading (1 zinc, 1 steel products). 4 discharging of which 1 steel, 1 coal, 1 alumina, 1 zinc concentrate. Gijon - Five vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 sugar, 1 cement, 1 wire rods). 2 Discharging of which 1 butane gas, 1 saw timber. Stevedore strike still in force.

TURKEY, Dec 10 - Mersin - 24 Vessels operating of which loading, 1 general cargo, 1 citrus, 1 glass, cement, 1 vetches, 1 soda, 4 pulses. Discharging, 1 general cargo, 2 oil, 1 sunflower seed, 1 vetches, 1 fuel oil. Both import and export of 4 container vessels, 13 vessels anchored. Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 7 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 2 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro/ no berthing delays. Galata - 12 cargo/passenger vessels operating/port congested. Ambarli - 15 vessels operating, no berthing delays. Mersin - Nine vessels awaiting orders. 17 Vessels operating of which loading, 2 citrus, 1 soda, 1 container/trailer, 1 general cargo/trailer, 1 glass, 2 legumes, 1 mineral, 1 livestock, 1 oil cake, 1 cement. Discharging, 1 bulk oil, 1 oil cake, 1 bulk sunflower. Loading/discharging, 1 vehicle, 1 container vessel. Free zone piers - No vessels. Seka - No vessels.

UKRAINE, Dec 9 - Mariupol - 12 vessels loading at berth (fertiliser, general cargo, urea, sunflower seed, sulphur, metal products, coal, containers). 2 Vessels discharging at berth (sunflower seed, metal products). 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (metal products, sulphur). 5 Sunflower seed vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 8 floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 1 Vessel under repair/drydock. 21 Vessels due (metal products, grain, sulphur, containers, general cargo, alumina, ore, sunflower seed, coal). Kerch - Five vessels under repair/drydock. 1 Vessel due to discharge chrome ore. Berdiansk - Two vessels loading at berth (metal products, fertiliser), 2 vessels discharging oranges at berth. 2 Vessels due (metal products, coal).

Dec 10 - Odessa - Steel cargo loading - 3 Vessels alongside, 6 due. Containers - 1 Vessel alongside, 2 due. GRAIN cargo loading - 2 Vessels alongside, 8 due. GRAIN cargo discharging, 1 vessel alongside. Tanker loading - 1 Vessel alongside, 1 due. General cargo - 4 Vessels alongside, 6 due. Odessa - 18 Vessels operating of which 8 loading, 10 discharging, 2 passenger vessels. 5 Vessels in roads of which 3 to load, 1 sunflowerseeds, 1 metal, 1 steel. 2 Vessels waiting. 22 Due of which 14 to load, 7 sunflowerseed, 5 metal, 1 oil, 1 barley. 8 To discharge, 2 containers, 3 citrus, 1 rice, 1 bananas, 1 general.

YUGOSLAVIA, Dec 10 - Bar - 11 Vessels berthed of which 3 discharging bananas, 1 discharging sinter magnesite, 2 discharging caustic acid. 3 Loading steel coils, 1 loading metal, 1 loading steel plates. Zelenika/Bijela - Three vessels in port, 3 under repair.
